situation (example wording): "Murders rolling over 6 months", "3-month rolling average", "rolling average" (no length)
what the app does today: Only a rolling 12-month total was read; other lengths and averages were declined.
proposed behavior: A rolling window of the length the question names (months or years: 3, 6, 12, 24 ...) is computed at that length: a total, or, when an average is asked, the window's total divided by its months, labeled as an average and never shown as the total. With no length named, ask which length.
exact default or choices offered: Length named: that length. Average named: the average per month (with the total beside a single figure). No length: ask, buttons 3, 6 and 12 months and another length.
why: A window's length and whether it is a sum or an average change every number.
status: Decided 2026-11-05 (Jeff: "rolling shouldn't just be 12 months"; "Ask which length"; "Answer the average")
test cases: Tests that cite this row: scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts.
